_readme: Machine-readable project status. Read this at the start of a session to orient; update it at the end of any task that changes what's built or what's broken. Prose belongs in the docs — this file is the ledger. Status values: not_started | in_progress | complete | blocked.
current_phase: POC code complete — next steps need hardware and corpus, not code

phase_0_skeleton.notes: Exit criterion verified 2026-07-30. The Phase 0 refuse-non-16kHz behavior was replaced in Phase 2 by automatic resampling; archival WAV was replaced in Phase 3 by Opus+AAC (WAV remains the no-ffmpeg fallback).

phase_1_transcription_detection.notes: All code items landed 2026-08-10: asr/ (mlx + faster_whisper behind Transcriber, warmup at startup), detect/ (hallucination gates, watchword matcher with phonetic guards per D14, LLM classifier with hard graceful degradation, severity resolution per architecture §5.5), incidents/correlator.py, scripts/replay.py + evaluate.py. 113 tests pass; ruff and mypy --strict clean. REMAINING (corpus-dependent, not code): hand-label data/labels.jsonl, run evaluate.py for a precision/recall baseline, and the base.en/small.en/medium.en WER comparison. Note: neither Whisper engine has been exercised against real audio yet — the first `python -m vhfwatch.pipeline --source file --path <wav>` run downloads the model (~500 MB) and is the real smoke test.

phase_2_live_audio.notes: All CODE items landed 2026-08-10: LiveAudioSource (device substring select, channel slice, gain warning, reconnect-with-backoff), soxr resampling wrapper, DirectoryAudioSource, calibrate.py, record_corpus.py, noise-floor drift warning, bounded queues with oldest-unflagged drop. NOT verified against hardware — the docs/hardware.md §5 bring-up procedure and the 30-minute segment-count exit criterion still stand between this and 'complete'. Do not debug software before §5 Step 4 passes.

phase_3_alerting_and_record.notes: Landed 2026-08-10: console/macos/pushover channels behind AlertChannel, router (alert-once-then-update, dedupe, escalation re-alert; no-ack escalation via Pushover priority 2 per D16), offline-complete notification body, share tokens (hash-only storage, access logged), FastAPI web app as a separate process with all §5.10 routes, canvas waveform per D15, honest uncertainty rendering, feedback + annotations. Exit criterion (replayed mayday → Pushover → phone) needs VHFWATCH_PUSHOVER_* set and a phone — untested end-to-end.

phase_4_reliability.notes: Watchdog, heartbeats, no-transmission alert, daily self-test, systemd units, x86 Linux verification. Noise-floor drift warning already exists in the pipeline tick; the rest is unbuilt. /health is honest about this gap.

phase_5_tuning.notes: Incident review with Parker, threshold retuning against real feedback labels, lead-time statistics.

corpus_collection.notes: scripts/record_corpus.py is ready — start it the moment either rig's audio chain works. This is the highest-value background activity and every Phase 1 measurement is blocked on it.

bringup_log.notes: docs/bringup-log.md is an empty template. No session has been recorded for either rig.

andy_m2.notes: Has a hardware input trim. Watch for the balanced-input phase-cancellation trap (docs/hardware.md §3.4).

parker_uca202.notes: No hardware input trim — the front knob is headphone output only. The radio's volume knob may be the only analog control, with input_gain_db as a post-capture last resort.

known_issues.description: The clips in audio-test-samples/ (and their 16 kHz conversions in data/corpus/) were recorded from the radio's speaker through a laptop mic, NOT through the line-in chain. They are useful only as smoke-test input for the pipeline. Do not tune segmenter thresholds against them, do not treat their noise floors (-60 to -77 dBFS) as representative, and do not use them for the Phase 1 WER comparison — wait for real line-in corpus audio.

Real ASR has never run: tests use a fake transcriber, so mlx-whisper/faster-whisper are exercised only at the import/signature level. First pipeline run downloads the model and is the true ASR smoke test.
LiveAudioSource's disconnect/reconnect path is untested against a real USB unplug — it needs a deliberate yank test during bring-up.
Neither rig's audio chain has been verified end to end. All segmenter thresholds are starting guesses derived from theory until scripts/calibrate.py runs on real hardware.

Pushover delivery is untested (needs VHFWATCH_PUSHOVER_TOKEN/USER and a phone). The Phase 3 exit criterion — alert deep link opens a playable incident record on a phone — has not been walked end to end.
The Tier 2 classifier prompt has never been evaluated against real traffic; llm_min_confidence=0.6 and the severity-resolution judgment calls in detect/detector.py are untuned defaults.
ASR model choice (base.en / small.en / medium.en) is unresolved pending measured WER on the real corpus. Config defaults to small.en.
The web app's 'dropped segments' honesty indicator is absent — nothing persists queue drops or pre-ASR rejects yet. Lands with Phase 4 health events.

open_questions: What is the actual traffic volume on Ch 16 at the POC site? This sets the 'no transmission in N hours' watchdog threshold (Phase 4 starts at 6 hours as a placeholder) and determines whether closed-squelch VAD is leaving too much on the table.
